title: Begin with God's love
content:
Take a quiet moment to remember that God meets you with love.

Name one way you have received care this week, and thank Him for it.

title: Trust the next step
content: Bring one decision to God in prayer. Choose a small, faithful step you can take today.

title: Practice gratitude
content: Notice three gifts in your ordinary day. Write them down and share encouragement with someone who needs it.
